updates.coverageDescription: This policy applies to multifamily residential buildings where the housing provider receives DND funding/land or has income-restricted units created under BPDA's Inclusionary Development Policy. The screening restrictions cover all units in qualifying buildings.
updates.coverageQuote: Housing providers receiving Department of Neighborhood Development (DND) funding and/or land, or that have income restricted units created under the Boston Planning and Development Agency (BPDA) Inclusionary Development Policy will not impose a blanket policy
